description: Caravelle VI-N c/n 146, ex I-DABV (SAM), flown by SAETA as HC-BDS until the 1990s; bought by the hacienda, converted into a café/bar and painted in a pseudo-Iberia scheme with 'Pastavi Airlines' titles. Private property, photography at the owner's discretion (jetphotos 28 October 2020).
